messages:
nicole: heads-up: sample-app smoke failing on embed indexing. curl with return_raw_metadata=true returns metadata, but js-sdk call returns none.

ryan: can you paste the failing call and SDK code?

nicole: curl works:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"inputs":["a","b"], "return_raw_metadata":true}'
```
response includes metadata[].

nicole: sdk snippet (js-sdk 1.9.0):
```js
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'open-embed-1',
  inputs: ['a','b'],
  returnRawMetadata: true
});
```

pras: sounds like param normalization. Our mapper accepts only known aliases and this flag is new. It never gets to transport.

ryan: more concerning: when REST triggers a slow metadata fetch it returns 202 + Location. SDK treats non-200 as an error and retries immediately. That caused double enqueue of indexing jobs in QA.

nicole: logs: job queued id=q_9876 then sdk retried and generated q_9877. Happened 2x.

ci-bot: recent deployment: embeddings-service v3.2.5 at 2146786000

pras: proposed fixes: 1) add return_raw_metadata alias mapping for returnRawMetadata in js-sdk; 2) update embeddings.create retry policy so 202 is considered accepted/terminal for this route; 3) add e2e in sample-app to assert single enqueue.

ryan: agree. Also update sample-app default request timeout (currently 8s) to 25s so we don't trigger client-side retry on expected slow metadata.

nicole: small docs ask: note that REST uses snake_case flags for experimental features; SDK should expose camelCase but map to snake_case when sending. mention in SDK CONTRIBUTING.md.

pras: will open two PRs: js-sdk#428 (param mapping + tests + README note) and js-sdk#429 (retry behavior + integration test). I'll include changelog entries and a test that uses a mocked 202 location header and verifies sdk does not retry.

ryan: one more: let's add a transient metric for duplicate-queue incidents so we can catch regressions. prod-monitoring owners? @ops-team in #eng-sre.

nicole: pinged ops. leaving thread until PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
